name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.2-beta+2

- All-in-one Home and one Library
  - Home can show Movies & TV rows: For you · Movies & TV and the built-in TMDB rows (Trending, Popular, In Theaters, streaming services…). For you and the two Trending rows are on by default; the rest are in Edit layout → Home. Continue Watching already mixes anime and Movies & TV.
  - Library: the Stremio chip is now "Everything": your anime and your Stremio Movies & TV in one grid, newest first, with status filters (Watching, Completed, Paused, Dropped, Planning) and Anime / Movies / Series. Anime synced to Stremio show once. The chip and filters are remembered.
